messages.subject: Testlet model M2 and RMSEA
parts:
Dear Dr. Chalmers and community,

I am trying to run a graded response testlet model or second order model with the the"mirt" function and "MHRM" specifically.

When doing so, I get an error message regarding the computation of M2 and the associated RMSEA that I want to get :

> M2_mod.md.bifactorGR<-M2(mod.md.bifactorGR, QMC=TRUE)
Error in rowSums(delta[, constrain[[i]]])

Could you please please help me in how to get M2 and associated RMSEA for this model ?

Could you also please tell me if my syntax is right regarding the model I want to run (testlet GRM)  with the the"mirt" function and "MHRM" specifically ?

I am sorry to ask these simple questions but I am a beginner with IRT and MIRT package.

Many thanks in advance.

Peter

Below the syntax :

library(mirt)
cp<-read.csv("cp.csv", sep=";")

# Testlet GR Model)
spec<-'G = 1-16
S1 = 1-3
S2 = 3-6
S3 = 6-9
S4 = 9-12
S5 = 12-16

CONSTRAIN = (1, a1,a2), (2, a1,a2), (3, a1,a2)

CONSTRAIN = (4,a1,a3), (5,a1,a3), (6,a1,a3)

CONSTRAIN = (7,a1,a4), (8,a1,a4), (9,a1,a4)

CONSTRAIN = (8,a1,a5), (9,a1,a5),(10,a1,a5)

CONSTRAIN = (10,a1,a6), (11,a1,a6), (12,a1,a6)

CONSTRAIN = (13,a1,a7),(14, a1,a7), (15,a1,a7), (16,a1,a7)

FREE = (GROUP, COV_22),(GROUP, COV_33),(GROUP, COV_44),(GROUP, COV_55),
(GROUP, COV_66)'

mod.md.bifactorGR<-mirt(cp,model=spec, itemtype='graded', SE=T, method='MHRM')
mod.md.bifactorGR

coef(mod.md.bifactorGR)

LD_mod.md.bifactorGR<-residuals(mod.md.bifactorGR, type="LD")
LD_mod.md.bifactorGR

Itemfit_mod.md.bifactorGR<-itemfit(mod.md.bifactorGR, QMC=TRUE)
Itemfit_mod.md.bifactorGR

M2_mod.md.bifactorGR<-M2(mod.md.bifactorGR, QMC=TRUE)
M2_mod.md.bifactorGR

messages.subject: Re: Testlet model M2 and RMSEA
parts:
I ran the following simulated example which is similar to yours, and didn't see any errors come up. Could you provide a reprex of this problem in case it persists?

```
#simulate data
set.seed(1234)
a <- matrix(0, 12, 4)
a[,1] <- rlnorm(12, .2, .3)
ind <- 1
for(i in 1:3){
    a[ind:(ind+3),i+1] <- a[ind:(ind+3),1]
    ind <- ind+4
}
print(a)
d <- rnorm(12, 0, .5)
sigma <- diag(c(1, .5, 1, .5))
dataset <- simdata(a,d,2000,itemtype=rep('2PL', 12),sigma=sigma)

# estimate by applying constraints and freeing the latent variances
specific <- c(rep(1,4),rep(2,4), rep(3,4))
model <- "G = 1-12
          CONSTRAIN = (1, a1, a2), (2, a1, a2), (3, a1, a2), (4, a1, a2),
            (5, a1, a3), (6, a1, a3), (7, a1, a3), (8, a1, a3),
            (9, a1, a4), (10, a1, a4), (11, a1, a4), (12, a1, a4)
          COV = S1*S1, S2*S2, S3*S3"

simmod <- bfactor(dataset, specific, model)
coef(simmod, simplify=TRUE)

M2(simmod, QMC=TRUE)

            M2 df       p      RMSEA RMSEA_5   RMSEA_95      SRMSR       TLI       CFI
stats 63.44929 51 0.11325 0.01105047       0 0.01901382 0.02837419 0.9964607 0.9972651
```

Phil
